idempotency.note: Sync dry-run labels every pre-existing row UPDATE (a dry run cannot tell identical from changed). Semantic idempotency is therefore proven by the field-level diff: the exact Airtable fields a re-sync would write, compared with live values (volatile run/updatedAt stamps excluded).
idempotency.classification: semantic = any customer/sales-meaningful payload key or flat Airtable column that would change; timestamp = updatedAt/lastVerifiedAt/lastResearchedAt re-stamped at write time; normalization = a re-sync merge adds null/false defaults and _airtableRecordId bookkeeping to the stored payload JSON (no value change).

otherHotels.caveat: Other-hotel hash covers id/hotelId/updatedAt/actionStatus/researchVersion/runId/decisionId/lastResearchedAt/schemaVersion/name/hotelFit per row; a concurrent external writer would show as a diff.
